metadata.description: Universal design principles for social media posts applicable to any aspect ratio (1:1, 5:6, 9:16, 16:9). Covers hierarchy, thirds rule, proximity, contrast, alignment, typography, reading patterns, balance, consistency, and color psychology
metadata.context: Complete guide for designing social media posts

metadata.description: Human eye processes information in order of size. Primary: 8-12% of total canvas height. Secondary: 40-50% of primary. Tertiary: 25-30% of primary. Quaternary: 20-25% of primary
metadata.context: How element size indicates importance in design

metadata.description: Divide canvas into 9 equal parts (3×3). Intersection points are natural power points. 1:1 center is strongest. 5:6 points are 1/3 top + 2/3 bottom. 9:16 safe zones at 20% from top/bottom
Related elements should be close; unrelated elements should be distant. Define Base Unit (UB) = 2% of smallest dimension. Intra-group: 1 UB. Inter-group: 3 UB. Margins: 4-6 UB
metadata.context: How to use spacing to group related items

metadata.description: Minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text. High-conversion palettes: dark mode (16:1), light mode (16:1), accent gradients (min 5:1). Always use dark overlay rgba(0,0,0,0.3) over photos with text

Centralized: inspiration, emotion, celebration (best for 1:1, 9:16). Left: education, lists, news, tutorials (best for 5:6, 16:9). Right: aesthetics, fashion, vanguard (moderate use). Justified: avoid in social media
Font combinations need contrast for differentiation but cohesion for unity. Max 2 fonts per post. Max 3 weights (Light, Regular, Bold). Min 1.5x proportion between different font sizes
Pattern Z (Zig-zag): 1:1 and 16:9 horizontal formats. Top-left → Diagonal → Bottom-right. Pattern F (Vertical): 5:6 and 9:16 vertical formats. Horizontal top → left descent → short horizontal lines
metadata.context: How eyes move through different aspect ratios

metadata.description: Elements have visual weight based on color, size, texture. Symmetrical: equal elements on both sides (formal, luxury). Asymmetrical: different elements with equal weights (dynamic). Radial: around center point (focus). Rule 40/60: 40% content, 60% whitespace
metadata.context: How to balance elements in a composition

metadata.description: Action/Buy (Red/Orange): urgency, alerts, CTAs. Trust/Professional (Blue): services, B2B, health, tech. Creativity/Innovation (Purple): art, fashion, spirituality. Growth/Nature (Green): sustainability, health, finance. Joy/Energy (Yellow): attention, optimism
metadata.context: How colors evoke emotions and behaviors
